deploy.title: Deploy a site
deploy.intro: Upload a zip and choose the domain to publish it at.
deploy.domain.label: Domain
deploy.domain.hint: Point the domain's DNS at this server. Deploying to an existing site replaces its files with the new release.
deploy.archive.label: Zip file
deploy.archive.dropHint: or click to choose a file
deploy.archive.hint: Up to {size}. If everything is inside one folder, this server publishes that folder's contents at the root.
deploy.noFile: Choose a zip file to deploy.
deploy.resolve.title: How a site answers requests
deploy.resolve.hint: Every site answers like a static host for single-page apps.
deploy.resolve.page: Serves `{htmlFile}` if it exists. If not, serves the nearest `index.html`, from `{folderIndex}` up to `{rootIndex}`.
deploy.resolve.asset: Served as it is. If it is missing, the answer is a `404`, not an HTML page.
deploy.resolve.notFound: If the site has one, it answers every path that matches nothing.
deploy.error.uploadLimit: The archive is larger than the {limit} upload limit.
deploy.error.notZip: That file is not a readable zip archive.
deploy.error.disk: The archive could not be written to disk. Check the server logs.
deploy.error.tooManyEntries: The archive holds more than the {max} allowed entries.
deploy.error.fileLimit: '{path}' is larger than the {limit} per-file limit.
deploy.error.noFiles: The archive contains no usable files.
deploy.error.expandsTo: The archive expands to {size}, over the {limit} limit.
deploy.error.extractionLimit: The archive expands to more than the configured extraction limit.
deploy.error.functionsAdministrators: This archive contains a `{folder}` folder, which only administrators can deploy because it runs as code on the server. Remove the folder, or ask an administrator to deploy it.
deploy.error.functionFileLimit: `{path}` is over the {limit} limit for one function file.
deploy.error.functionsDidNotBuild: Nothing was deployed: the functions did not build. {error}
deploy.warning.skipped.one: {count} entry was skipped (unsafe path or excluded name).
deploy.warning.skipped.other: {count} entries were skipped (unsafe path or excluded name).
deploy.warning.functionFileIgnored: `{path}` was ignored: only `.cs` and `.linq` files directly inside `{folder}` are compiled.
deploy.warning.noFunctionFiles: `{folder}` holds no `.cs` or `.linq` files, so the site keeps the functions it had.
deploy.warning.noIndex: No `index.html` was found at the root of the site — requests will fall back to a 404.
deploy.warning.ruleFileLarge: '{name}' is larger than {limit} and was ignored.
deploy.warning.missingVariables.one: The variable {names} is required but has no value. Set it under Variables on the site page.
deploy.warning.missingVariables.other: The variables {names} are required but have no value. Set them under Variables on the site page.
